THIRD-PARTY NOTICES
===================

The student site redistributes the following library, unmodified, for offline use.

Chart.js 4.5.1
  Files:    vendor/chart.js/chart.umd.js (UMD build from the npm package chart.js@4.5.1)
  License:  MIT License, Copyright (c) 2014-2024 Chart.js Contributors
  Text:     vendor/chart.js/LICENSE.md
  Source:   https://www.chartjs.org/  (package obtained from the npm registry on 16 September 2026)
  Used by:  numeric charts only (Week 11 latency distribution); every chart has a data table beside it.

Fonts: the site uses system fonts only (Segoe UI Variable / Segoe UI, Cascadia Mono / Consolas,
with generic fallbacks). No font files are redistributed.

Everything else in the site (styles, scripts, diagrams, fixtures, text) was authored for this course.
